title: The Sponsor Gap
description: A sponsor-money case where financial records, deleted camera metadata, and one office alibi expose a calculated cover-up.

answerKey.method: He switched Lena’s allergy-safe drink and hid her emergency injector during the sponsor-reveal window.
answerKey.motive: He needed to stop Lena from exposing stolen sponsor money routed through private vendor invoices.
answerKey.keyEvidence: The camera export gap, sponsor deposit records, fake invoice metadata, and safe-access log connect Owen to both the motive and the cover-up.
answerKey.explanation: Owen controlled the sponsor files and office security export. Forensics shows the exact corridor window was removed, the fake vendor trail came from his office computer, and the safe log places him near the hidden injector.

phone.title: Recovered Phone Analysis: Missed Calls
phone.text: Lena missed two calls from Owen at 7:41 and 7:44 PM, then received a nine-second call as she left the host table.
phone.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

messages.title: Message Extraction Report: Private Meeting
messages.text: Lena texted Owen, “We need to talk before the reveal,” and Owen replied, “Patio corridor. No staff.”
messages.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

maps.title: Location Analysis: Corridor Overlap
maps.text: Lena’s phone and Owen’s phone both register near the patio corridor during the sponsor reveal window.
maps.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

bank.title: Financial Records Review: Duplicate Sponsor Deposit
bank.text: The sponsor deposit appears once in the public event ledger and again under a private vendor label.
bank.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

bank.title: Final Financial Summary: Sponsor Theft Motive
bank.text: Forensics links the duplicate deposit, private vendor invoice, and Owen’s office export into one sponsor-money cover-up.
bank.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

photos.title: Photo / Video Review: Missing Injector
photos.text: A hallway still shows Lena reaching into her clutch, but the emergency injector is not inside the open pocket.
photos.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Owen Landry
contacts.text: Owen says he called Lena only to calm her down about sponsor timing and never met her alone in the corridor.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Tessa Marchand
contacts.text: Tessa says Owen kept checking the office door and looked angry after Lena asked about the sponsor folder.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Marisol Vega
contacts.text: Marisol says Owen controlled the final sponsor spreadsheet and refused to let finance review it before the reveal.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Brielle Fox
contacts.text: Brielle says she saw Owen return from the corridor while everyone else was watching the sponsor screen.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Cole Darden
contacts.text: Cole says Owen told staff the camera system “glitched,” even before anyone asked for the footage.

notes.title: Physical Evidence Report: Safe Access Log
notes.text: The office safe was opened with Owen’s code minutes before Lena collapsed. The injector wrapper was later found in the safe trash liner.
notes.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

files.title: Document / Metadata Review: Security Export Gap
files.text: The security export skips the exact corridor window. File properties show the export came from Owen’s manager login.
files.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

files.title: Document / Metadata Review: Fake Invoice Template
files.text: The private vendor invoice was created on Owen’s office computer before the event began.
files.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

browser.title: Browser History Review: Metadata Removal
browser.text: The office browser searched how to remove metadata from exported security clips.
browser.source: Recovered from the scene and processed by Forensics.

revealScript: Owen tried to make the death look like a chaotic event accident, but Forensics made the sponsor gap visible. The money trail gave him motive, the camera gap proved a cover-up, and the safe log connected him to the missing injector.
